messages:
maria (AE): @raj quick heads-up — StratusCore POC just came back with three blockers: 1) BYO-KMS + HSM attestation, 2) a hard pricing cap request for month 1, 3) legal wants a security discovery call today. Can we get a short exec bridge if needed?
raj (SE): On KMS — we support BYO-KMS for Private and Dedicated. Need to confirm HSM attestation level they require (FIPS 140-2 vs 140-3). Do we have a template attestation note?
ana (Security): @raj I can share our hardware attestation summary. If they need customer-managed HSM with key escrow restrictions that's a bigger change. Send me their questionnaire items now.
tim (Eng): For throughput: if they route heavy embedding workloads we may need to provision an extra dedicated pool. That impacts pricing; what's the cap they're asking for?
maria (AE): They proposed a $60k cap for month 1 (pilot + integration). Sales asked if we can do a bridge discount and commit to a forecast. Also they want 30-day SLA for latency P90.
olivia (PS): If we do a one-month reserved commit to hit the cap we can guarantee baseline throughput. PS can scope a minimal runbook for onboarding and can own the discovery call.
raj (SE): Can you forward the KMS question from legal? I need the exact attestation text so I can validate with infra. If they want `GetKeyAttestation()` logs we might need to add logging hooks.
ana (Security): Attached Qs (copied inline): 1) Are private keys stored in HW-backed keystore? 2) Do you provide key rotation APIs? 3) Can Redwood provide an HSM attestation certificate for customer-managed keys?
ops-bot: Ticket #INC-2026-719 created for StratusCore KMS & pricing escalation. Assignee: @tim (Eng). Priority: high.
tim (Eng): Taking ticket. I'll triage KMS feasibility by EOD. If attestation requires vendor-signed cert we'll need 2-3 days to get procurement involved.
maria (AE): Thanks — can someone escalate to @cto for a 1pm exec bridge standby? Customer says they may pause the pilot if we can't confirm attestation tomorrow.
raj (SE): @cto tagging in DM. For now I can promise we have a path; need confirmation on exact attestation type.
ana (Security): I can join the discovery call at 10:30 or 3pm PT today. Which works for StratusCore?
maria (AE): I've asked for 3pm PT. I'll post the calendar invite once I hear back.
olivia (PS): I'll draft a minimal onboarding runbook and a temporary SLA note we can present on the call — focused on latency P90, incident response, and escalation steps.
tim (Eng): Quick note: if we commit to the pricing cap and need extra GPUs, finance will need a one-off approval for short-term capacity. Tagging @finance in the bridge if we hit that route.
maria (AE): Perfect. For status tracking: update the ticket with answers + link to call recording. I'll follow up with StratusCore after the call and capture their final ask. :raised_hands:
